target_customer: Originally US business owners selling to employees via ESOPs; now ESOP advisory firms, administrators, trustees and ESOP companies
problem: Many retiring baby boomer owners lack succession options; ESOPs offer tax benefits but are complex to set up and administer.
business_model: Software and services for ESOP setup and administration, now an AI platform (Peninsula) for advisory firms

founders.name: Roger Cawdette
education: Harvard, Technological & Social Innovation; left after sophomore year

founders.name: Turja Chowdhury
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no further background.

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow software over ESOP rules; expertise in compliance matters more than engineering depth.

defensibility.rationale: Administration data and adviser workflows create stickiness, but the niche has established TPAs and general equity tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Those tools focus on startup option plans, not trust-based ESOPs; no incumbent move found.

market_need_then: YC description cites 2.9 million baby boomer owners set to retire and ESOPs covering 14 million workers (company figures).

branding.domain_note: YC lists villagelabs.app, which now redirects to villagelabs.com (observed 2026-11).

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission driven: more employee ownership across America

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand; name is generic and shared with other Village companies.

pivots.from: Helping businesses set up and manage ESOPs directly
pivots.to: AI platform and services for ESOP advisory firms (Peninsula)
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from the current website versus the YC description.

outcome_analysis: Village Labs is an active Summer 2024 ESOP company that appears to have moved from serving owners directly to selling AI software to ESOP advisers. No exit or failure was found; funding figures conflict widely across aggregators and none is verified, so no success factors are asserted.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting: vcbacked and startups.fm 500K pre-seed 2024-09; Dealroom 125K seed and 750K total; PitchBook snippet shows 3.5M (2022) and 12.5M (2025-03), which may belong to a different Village Labs; PremierAlts says 16M total but also no rounds on record. None recorded as rounds. Pivot is inferred, not announced. Competitor list left empty because search returned only generic equity software pages without dates near the batch. Completeness pass: the 2024-09 $500K pre-seed rests on VCBacked and Startups.fm. Dealroom's $125K seed and $750K total conflict (also lists New York Ventures) and are not recorded. PitchBook 12.5M and Alphagrowth 3M likely belong to other companies.
